# Acovia

Acovia warms the colours of the Obsidian interface, which the recorded description ties to reduced eye strain and calls out particularly for dark mode. It aims to hold comfortable contrast and readable typography across the app. Its palette values, mode list and settings are not recorded beyond that.

![Acovia screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fovlin/obsidian-acovia-theme/HEAD/exp-dark.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Acovia"
    author: "Fovlin"
    repo:   "fovlin/obsidian-acovia-theme"
    slug:   "acovia"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/acovia"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/fovlin/obsidian-acovia-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fovlin/obsidian-acovia-theme/HEAD/exp-dark.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply warm-toned colors to soften the interface and reduce eye strain, especially in dark mode. Maintain comfortable contrast and readable typography across Obsidian."
}
```
